title: Bond strength from two curing ovens
intro: A plant cures adhesive joints in two ovens and measures the bond strength (kN). Oven A: 8 joints, mean 24.6, standard deviation 1.2. Oven B: 12 joints, mean 23.5, standard deviation 2.1. H₀: μ_A − μ_B = 0 against H₁: μ_A − μ_B ≠ 0 at α = 0.05, by Welch's t-test.
